answer: A pasted memo cannot occupy a silt-core window. After a 19.2 POA bond, desk RD-7 issues barrel CB-2208. The agent walks 640 m down the west levee of the silt delta, sinks the barrel 1.35m, and returns a 280 g wet plug by minute 29. They log 4.8 ug/L chlorophyll at pond P-3 in the salt garden and hold transponder TP-61 on the barrier reef for 12s. Two stewards from SHA-256(seed||barrel||k), k=0..1, reweigh the plug and replay the ping. A reused barrel, plug under 200 g, or mute ping keeps 7.4 POA and parks the key five epochs; 11.8 POA unlocks after a later barrel with new pond and transponder.
